title: Setting up dashboards to monitor performance metrics with QuickSight [Hands-On]

cues.en: Hello, my friends, and welcome to this new hands-on tutorial on how to monitor performance metrics, with two new solutions that might come up at the exam.
cues.zh: 各位朋友，歡迎來到這堂新的實作教學。我們要用兩個考試可能出現的新方案，監控效能指標。

cues.en: But before I reveal them to you, I just wanna do a quick recap.
cues.zh: 不過，在揭曉之前，先快速複習。

cues.en: So whenever it's about monitoring your machine learning model in-production, think Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor,
cues.zh: 只要談到監控正式環境中的機器學習模型，就想到 Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor。

cues.en: whenever it's about troubleshooting performance issues, such as latency of your machine learning models, think X-Ray, or CloudWatch Lambda Insights,
cues.zh: 若是排查機器學習模型延遲等效能問題，就想到 X-Ray 或 CloudWatch Lambda Insights，

cues.en: or CloudWatch Logs Insights, okay?
cues.zh: 或 CloudWatch Logs Insights。

cues.en: And now I'm gonna show you two other tools that are useful for monitoring performance of your machine learning models, but through dashboards.
cues.zh: 現在我要介紹另外兩個工具，透過儀表板監控機器學習模型的效能。

cues.en: So if, at the exam, you have any question that mentions dashboard that you set up to monitor your machine learning model performance, well, think those two tools that I'm about to show you,
cues.zh: 所以考題若提到設定儀表板來監控機器學習模型效能，就想到接下來這兩個工具。

cues.en: which are first QuickSight, which is like the Tableau of AWS, in which you can indeed set up some dashboards in order to monitor the performance of your machine learning models.
cues.zh: 第一個是 QuickSight，很像 AWS 版的 Tableau，可以設定儀表板來監控機器學習模型的效能。

cues.en: And the second tool is CloudWatch Dashboards.
cues.zh: 第二個是 CloudWatch Dashboards。

cues.en: Okay, so here we go.
cues.zh: 好，開始吧。

cues.en: I'm just gonna show them to you, once again, in order to give you some visuals so that you can remember better.
cues.zh: 我再帶你看一下畫面，幫助你加深記憶。

cues.en: So let's start with the first one, which is Amazon QuickSight.
cues.zh: 先從第一個 Amazon QuickSight 開始。

cues.en: Amazon QuickSight, fast, easy to use business analytics, just like Tableau, but the integrated service of AWS.
cues.zh: Amazon QuickSight 提供快速、易用的商業分析，和 Tableau 類似，但它是 AWS 的整合服務。

cues.en: And indeed, inside QuickSight you can set up some dashboards, which would then allow you to monitor the performance of your machine learning models with whatever metric you are defining
cues.zh: 在 QuickSight 中，你可以設定儀表板，透過你定義的任何指標，監控機器學習模型的效能，

cues.en: or using inside your dashboard.
cues.zh: 或使用儀表板中的既有指標。

cues.en: Okay, so indeed, in order to use QuickSight, or Quick Suite by Amazon, well, we have to sign up for it.
cues.zh: 要使用 QuickSight，或 Amazon 的 Quick Suite，我們得先註冊。

cues.en: So I'm gonna do that super quickly so that you can at least see what Amazon Quick Suite looks like.
cues.zh: 我快速操作，至少讓你看看 Amazon Quick Suite 的介面。

cues.en: All right, so here, yes, Cloud Wolf, email cloudwolf2025@gmail.com.
cues.zh: 這裡填 Cloud Wolf，電子郵件是 cloudwolf2025@gmail.com。

cues.en: That's actually the email used for this account in which I'm doing this CMLE course.
cues.zh: 這就是我錄製這門 CMLE 課程所用帳戶的電子郵件。

cues.en: US East North Virginia, password-based, yes, perfect.
cues.zh: US East，也就是維吉尼亞北部；以密碼登入，沒錯。

cues.en: And we're gonna use an AWS Managed Key.
cues.zh: 我們使用 AWS 受管金鑰。

cues.en: Yes, so create account, creating your account, and in a couple of seconds you'll get to see what the Amazon Quick Suite, or QuickSight,
cues.zh: 按 Create account，正在建立帳戶。再過幾秒，你就能看到 Amazon Quick Suite，也就是 QuickSight，

cues.en: looks like in order to, remember, set up dashboards, allowing you to monitor the performance of your machine learning models through different metrics that you are either using or defining.
cues.zh: 如何讓你設定儀表板，使用既有或自行定義的不同指標，監控機器學習模型的效能。

cues.en: Okay, discover, analyze, act, automate.
cues.zh: 好，探索、分析、採取行動、自動化。

cues.en: Turn data into meaningful insights easily.
cues.zh: 輕鬆將資料轉為有意義的洞察。

cues.en: You know, it's like, there we go, account created successfully.
cues.zh: 就像……好了，帳戶已成功建立。

cues.en: I was gonna say, it's like business intelligence.
cues.zh: 我剛才要說，它就像商業智慧工具。

cues.en: All right, so let's go to Amazon Quick Suite.
cues.zh: 好，前往 Amazon Quick Suite。

cues.en: Welcome to QuickSight.
cues.zh: 歡迎使用 QuickSight。

cues.en: Welcome to Amazon Quick Suite.
cues.zh: 歡迎使用 Amazon Quick Suite。

cues.en: It's gonna load in a couple of seconds.
cues.zh: 再過幾秒就會載入。

cues.en: Your samples have been successfully created, perfect.
cues.zh: 範例已成功建立，很好。

cues.en: Okay, show me more.
cues.zh: 好，Show me more。

cues.en: No.
cues.zh: 不要。

cues.en: Oh, your new agent teammate for smarter, faster work.
cues.zh: 喔，你的新代理隊友，讓工作更聰明、更快速。

cues.en: Get the answers you need quickly using all your data.
cues.zh: 使用所有資料，快速取得你需要的答案。

cues.en: That's good.
cues.zh: 不錯。

cues.en: We see agentic AI everywhere now, right?
cues.zh: 現在到處都看得到代理式 AI，對吧？

cues.en: So we can click show me more, Navigating Quick Suite.
cues.zh: 可以按 Show me more，看看如何操作 Quick Suite。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So they are basically guiding you on how to get started, but there we go.
cues.zh: 基本上，它在引導你入門。好了。

cues.en: Welcome to Amazon Quick Suite, and actually, why not, already getting some help from our assistant by, for example, asking,
cues.zh: 歡迎使用 Amazon Quick Suite。我們也可以立即請助理幫忙，例如問：

cues.en: "Hi, please help me set up a dashboard for machine learning."
cues.zh: 「你好，請幫我設定一個機器學習儀表板。」

cues.en: All right, pressing enter, and let's see what it's gonna suggest.
cues.zh: 按 Enter，看看它會給什麼建議。

cues.en: Checking Quick Suite documentation, checking Quick Suite documentation again, and, "I'll help you set up a dashboard for machine learning using Amazon Quick Suite.
cues.zh: 正在查閱 Quick Suite 文件，又查了一次。它說：「我會幫你使用 Amazon Quick Suite 設定機器學習儀表板。

cues.en: Based on the documentation, here's how to create a dashboard.
cues.zh: 根據文件，以下是建立儀表板的方法。

cues.en: Getting started with dashboard creation.
cues.zh: 開始建立儀表板。

cues.en: Step-by-step process.
cues.zh: 逐步流程。

cues.en: First step, access dashboard creation, create an analysis first, prepare your ML data, create visualizations, and publish as dashboard."
cues.zh: 第一步，進入儀表板建立功能；先建立分析、準備機器學習資料、建立視覺化，最後發布為儀表板。」

cues.en: Okay, excellent, so you will find your dashboards here.
cues.zh: 很好，你的儀表板會出現在這裡。

cues.en: Then in order to create your first dashboard, you need to publish an analysis.
cues.zh: 要建立第一個儀表板，得先發布一個分析。

cues.en: So we're gonna go to analysis, and then we're gonna click create analysis, and then, as you can see, you just follow the steps that were just mentioned by our assistant.
cues.zh: 所以前往 Analyses，再按 Create analysis。接著照著助理剛才列出的步驟操作即可。

cues.en: You first create the data set, like in Canvas, actually, you upload the file, but there you go.
cues.zh: 先建立資料集，其實和 Canvas 很像，要上傳檔案。

cues.en: That's how you get started with Quick Suite.
cues.zh: 這就是 Quick Suite 的入門方式。

cues.en: And then after you upload your data and prepared it, you can create visualizations using that AutoGraph functionality that can automatically suggest appropriate visualizations
cues.zh: 上傳並準備好資料後，可以用 AutoGraph 功能建立視覺化；它會自動建議適合的視覺化方式，

cues.en: for your ML data.
cues.zh: 用來呈現機器學習資料。

cues.en: Okay, and then finally you publish as dashboard.
cues.zh: 最後發布為儀表板。

cues.en: All right, I think that should be largely enough for the CMLE exam, whenever you see in the question dashboard to monitor the performance of your machine learning models,
cues.zh: 我想這樣對 CMLE 考試就很足夠了。題目若提到用儀表板監控機器學習模型效能，

cues.en: well, think QuickSight.
cues.zh: 就想到 QuickSight。

cues.en: And now I look forward to seeing you in the next hands-on tutorial, and until then, enjoy machine learning with AWS.
cues.zh: 期待在下一堂實作教學再見到你。在那之前，享受 AWS 機器學習的樂趣吧。
